decisions.decision: Treat LLMs as nondeterministic workers, never as system authority.
Use AgentPhone exclusively for telephony; do not introduce Twilio.
Use AgentMail exclusively for application email.
Use Neon Data API as the only application database access path.
All engineering work is bounded by machine-readable change contracts and drift certification.
Production deployment is triggered only by merging to main.
Build ZeroAI as the deterministic control plane between the developer and the user's chosen AI provider, following contracts/runtime-plan.json in milestone order R1 through R4.
